plain_mechanism: Primitive colour modes are scalars under physical rotation. Right colour Gauss plus centre sewing makes their dressed source d†=D(U)epsilon c† a physical left-field differential halfspin source. The explicit source-derived intertwiner sum_m d_m d_m†=I on the odd doublet is carried into a new 2x2x2 cubic mobile packet. Its links are full Peierls exponentials of three vector field coordinates; current is differentiated from those same links. A local field-coordinate unitary produces a later remote packet/current response and changes the actual projected frame-coordinate S_z under the common frame-metric Hamiltonian. The result is a finite one-mobile-source candidate, not the complete two-species physical target.
target_backward_path: The Wave5 frame source supplied field-derived physical halfspin but lacked translation; the Wave5 quantum event supplied a local causal field/current/spin event but had primitive Pauli spin and a different common-H root. This continuation restores position degrees and derives the hopping intertwiner from the frame source rather than inserting a bare spin label. It retains the Gauss-projected source, source/H state semantics, full angular internal metric, current/contact-bearing Peierls exponential, and adjacent N=1 to N=2 source channel in one new finite construction.

actual_consumer.explanation: The unitary pulse changes field energy locally at t=0 while the remote detector remains unchanged; the subsequently changing opposite-corner probability is absent when all links are removed or field-dependent link coupling is switched off. This is a causal finite-field-coordinate transport result, not a one-photon scattering or asymptotic-state result.

contrast.versus_frame_gauss: Adds real position-space motion and same-link field/current legs to the source-derived physical halfspin. Does not replace the rigid carrier by a self-bound continuum object.
contrast.versus_quantum_collision: Uses the field-coordinate spin operator derived from the right-Gauss/centre-sewn frame source, not primitive Pauli spin; however it has one mobile charged species and no mobile supplier.
contrast.versus_all_link_cut: Full-link cut produces exactly zero remote field-pulse response, while uncut reaches .00706846 by t=6.
contrast.versus_current_off: Removing vector-coordinate dependence from the hopping while preserving spatial hopping suppresses the remote response to <=7.8e-16.

inputs_and_limits: Primitive colour fundamental, CAR, centre sewing/spin structure, Gaussian charge profile, local inertias and quadratic longitudinal electric law are retained inputs.
Pinned 2x2x2 cubic scaffold has cubic symmetry only; spatial exact Noether-vector claims, free COM, Lorentz covariance and a continuum electron are unpaid.
Three vector oscillators are local finite modes, not spatial photons; field cutoff convergence is not established.
Only one mobile species is present. Two-species all-link/current-off controls, a mobile adjacent-charge packet, inclusive interaction and scattering remain unpaid.
No self-binding, electron mass, pair/positron sector, photon continuum, or parameter closure follows.
